result.response:
```README.md
# Mike Logger

## Overview
Mike Logger is a project that provides a simple and efficient way to log audio data from a microphone. It is designed to be used in a variety of applications, such as voice recording, audio analysis, and speech recognition.

## Features
- Supports multiple audio input devices (e.g., built-in microphone, USB microphone)
- Allows for real-time audio recording and logging
- Provides options for configuring audio sample rate, bit depth, and number of channels
- Includes a command-line interface (CLI) for easy integration into scripts and workflows
- Supports saving audio data in various file formats (e.g., WAV, FLAC, MP3)
- Includes a Python API for programmatic control and integration

## Installation
To install Mike Logger, you can use pip:

```
pip install mike-logger
```

Alternatively, you can clone the repository and install it from the source:

```
git clone https://github.com/your-username/mike-logger.git
cd mike-logger
python setup.py install
```

## Usage
Mike Logger can be used from the command line or programmatically through the Python API. Here's an example of how to use the CLI to record audio for 10 seconds and save it to a WAV file:

```
mike-logger record --duration 10 --output-file my_recording.wav
```

And here's an example of how to use the Python API to record audio and save it to a FLAC file:

```
from mike_logger import MikeLogger

logger = MikeLogger()
logger.start_recording()
logger.stop_recording(output_file='my_recording.flac')
```

For more detailed usage information, please refer to the [documentation](https://github.com/your-username/mike-logger/blob/main/docs/usage.md).

## Contributing
We welcome contributions to the Mike Logger project! If you'd like to contribute, please follow the guidelines in the [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/your-username/mike-logger/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) file.

## License
Mike Logger is licensed under the [MIT License](https://github.com/your-username/mike-logger/blob/main/LICENSE).
```
